encounters.name: Stray Briarthorn Wolf
encounters.introProse: A low snarl breaks the quiet of Whispering Grove as a Briarthorn Wolf bounds out from the ferns!

victoryOutcome.text: The wolf retreats limping into the thickets, leaving the grove trail safe.

encounters.name: Watchtower Raider Duo
encounters.introProse: Two scavengers step from the tumbled masonry! A Shield-Raider guards the frontline while a Stone-Slinger takes aim from the backline.

victoryOutcome.text: With the raiders routed, the Old Watchtower Ruins are yours to search freely.

encounters.name: The Beacon Cliff Sentinel
encounters.introProse: Bronze plates grind together as the Cinder-Horn Sentinel rises before the unlit brazier, raising its stone halberd in salute!

victoryOutcome.text: The Sentinel kneels in bronze sparks and yields the Consecrated Beacon Flint. The brazier awaits your spark!
